company.name: Guardant Health
company.shortDescription: Guardant Health is a precision oncology company that uses blood tests, data sets, and analytics to provide treatment to cancer patients.
company.description: Guardant Health is committed to positively and significantly impacting patient health through technology breakthroughs that address long-standing unmet needs in oncology. Guardant is backed by Sequoia Capital, led by a seasoned management team comprising thought leaders and successful serial entrepreneurs in next-generation sequencing and rare-cell diagnostics, and is closely advised by an oncologist-led medical steering committee from leading cancer centers across North America and abroad.

productsAndServices.description: A portfolio of blood- and tissue-based oncology tests that provides genomic and molecular insights for cancer treatment selection, recurrence monitoring, and therapy-response assessment.
productsAndServices.name: Guardant Complete® Portfolio

productsAndServices.description: A blood-based screening test for colorectal cancer intended to provide a more convenient screening option by analyzing cancer-related signals in blood.
productsAndServices.name: Shield™ Blood Test

productsAndServices.description: A multiomic technology platform combining genomic, epigenomic, and RNA-based fusion data for liquid and tissue profiling, minimal residual disease detection, and response monitoring.
productsAndServices.name: Guardant Infinity™

productsAndServices.description: Precision-oncology services for biopharmaceutical companies, including translational research and the use of blood-based genomic data to support drug development.
productsAndServices.name: Biopharma Solutions

productsAndServices.description: An artificial intelligence offering from Guardant Health intended to use oncology data and analytics to generate insights for cancer screening, diagnosis, treatment, or research.
productsAndServices.name: InfinityAI

productsAndServices.description: A billing and financial-assistance support service that helps providers and patients manage payment processes and reduce unexpected out-of-pocket costs for genomic testing.
productsAndServices.name: Guardant Access Program

aiResearchSummary.text: Guardant Health is researching systems and methods for detecting rare mutations and copy number variations in cell-free polynucleotides, as described in 'Systems and methods to detect rare mutations and copy number variation.' They are also developing approaches for detecting the presence of tumors based on methylation status of cell-free DNA, as outlined in 'Detecting the presence of a tumor based on methylation status of cell-free DNA.' These efforts focus on non-invasive cancer detection and genomic profiling.

insights.title: Hybrid therapeutic platform
insights.statement: Guardant Health combines Biopharma Solutions with InfinityAI.
insights.implication: The company is positioned as a biotechnology platform with both a physical therapeutic-delivery modality and an AI-assisted discovery layer, rather than as a standalone AI software vendor.
caveats: Product descriptions are profile claims and do not establish clinical efficacy.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Post IPO Debt round raised $350,000,000, or 13.86% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 13 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 92 (-7 over 90 days) and market heat at 67 (+3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Tempus, Freenome, BioAffinity Technologies.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
